newsitem.title: INDIA: Goldman Sachs chief to address Bombay meeting.
newsitem.headline: Goldman Sachs chief to address Bombay meeting.

text.p: Peter Sutherland, chairman of investment firm Goldman Sachs International, will deliver the keynote address at a management seminar in Bombay on Friday, All India Management Association president K.B. Dadiseth said.
The two-day conference will focus on "Innovation for corporate renaissance," Dadiseth told reporters on Thursday.

Other speakers include J.J. Irani, managing director of Tata Iron and Steel Company, K.V. Kamath, managing director of Industrial Credit and Investment Corp of India (ICICI), Kito de Boer, Principal of McKinsey & Co and Robert Eichfeld, chief executive officer of Citibank, organisers said.

At the function, the first J.R.D. Tata Corporate Leadership Award will be given posthumously to Aditya Vikram Birla, chief of the Aditya Birla Group, a leading Indian business house, who died last year.
"There is something magical about the house of Tatas giving the award to (the late) Birla," Dadiseth said.
